## Gates

- [ ] `bun run typecheck` green
- [ ] Covering tests green (the tests that exercise this change)
- [ ] e2e suite green if the change touches its tier (`scripts/e2e.sh <suite>`)
- [ ] Docs reconciled (docs gate) or docs-only change
- [ ] Parity: names the `docs/parity.md` cells this changes (row and column) and updates them, or changes no harness or mode capability (CONTRIBUTING.md §Keep harnesses at parity)
